# Project Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

source('https://inkaverse.com/setup.r')
```

# Data import

```{r}
gs <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1QziIXGOwb8cl3GaARJq6Ez6aU7vND_UHKJnFcAKx0VI/edit?gid=800931632#gid=800931632" %>% 
  as_sheets_id()

pisum <- gs %>% 
  range_read(ss = .,sheet = "pisum") %>% 
  mutate(across(c(1:9), ~ as.factor(.))) 

pisum %>% str()
```

# Multivariate

```{r}
#| eval: false

library(factoextra)

dtx <- pisum %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c("plots", "ntreat", "sort", "block", "rows", "cols", "seeds")) %>% 
  group_by(Inoculant, peg) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
  
  unite("rowname", c("Inoculant", "peg"), remove = F, sep = "-") %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "rowname") %>% 
  as.data.frame()

str(dtx)
  
mv <- dtx %>% 
  PCA(scale.unit = T
      , graph = F
      , quali.sup = c(1, 2))

var <- mv %>% 
  plot.PCA(choix = c("var"), cex=0.7)

var

cos <- mv %>% 
  
  fviz_pca_var(col.var = "cos2"
               , gradient.cols = inti:::paleta()
               , repel = TRUE
               , labelsize = 2)

cos

ind <- mv %>% 
  plot.PCA(choix = c("ind")
           , cex = 0.7
           , label = "ind"
           , invisible = "quali"
           , col.hab = inti:::paleta()
           , habillage = "none"
           )

pcainfo <- factoextra::get_pca(mv); pcainfo

pcainfo$cor %>% kable(caption = "Variable correlations")
pcainfo$contrib %>% kable(caption = "Variable Contribution")
pcainfo$cos2 %>% kable(caption = "Variable Cos2")

cls <- mv %>% HCPC(nb.clust = -1, graph = FALSE)

map <- \() {plot.HCPC(cls, choice = "map", draw.tree = FALSE)}

cls$call$t$tree
cls$data.clust %>% 
  kable(caption = "Cluster membership of each individual")  
cls$desc.var$quanti %>% 
  kable(caption = "Quantitative variables characterizing each cluster")
cls$desc.var$category %>% 
  kable(caption = "Categorical variables significantly by cluster")  
table(cls$data.clust$clust) %>% 
  kable(caption = "Number of individuals assigned to each cluster")

plot <- list(var, cos, ind, map()) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, labels = "auto")

dir.create("manuscript", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(plot = plot, "manuscript/multivariate.jpg", units = "cm"
                , width = 30, height = 30)

include_graphics("manuscript/multivariate.jpg")
```


# PCA information

```{r}

c1 <- fviz_eig(mv, 
                addlabels = TRUE,
                hjust = 0.05,
                barfill = "white",
                barcolor = "darkblue",
                linecolor = "red") + 
  # ylim(0, 30) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA - percentage of explained variances",
    y = "Variance (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)
    , axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

c1


c2 <- fviz_contrib(mv,
                     choice = "var", 
                     axes = 1, 
                     top = 10,
                     fill = "white",
                     color = "darkblue"
                   , sort.val = "asc"
                   ) +
  # ylim(0, 8) +
  labs(title = "Dim 1 - variables contribution", x = "") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)
    , axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

c2


c3 <- fviz_contrib(mv,
                     choice = "var", 
                     axes = 2, 
                     top = 10,
                     fill = "white",
                     color = "darkblue"
                   , sort.val = "asc"
                   ) +
  # ylim(0, 8) +
  labs(title = "Dim 2 - variables contribution", x = "") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)
    , axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

c3


lpanel <- c(c1, c2, c3) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 1, labels = "auto"
            , rel_heights = c(1, 1.2, 1.2))
  

rpanel <- \() {
  
pcainfo$cos2[, 1:2] %>% 
  corrplot(
    is.corr = F
    , method = "number",
    type = "full",
    tl.col = "black",
    tl.srt = 45,
    tl.cex = 0.9, 
    number.cex = 0.5, 
    number.digits = 1,
    cl.cex = 0.7,
    cl.pos = "r",
    cl.align = "r",
    cl.ratio = 4 
  )

}


grid <- c(lpanel, rpanel) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, labels = c("", "d"))


ggsave(
  plot = grid,
  "manuscript/contribution.jpg",
  units = "cm",
  width = 28,
  height = 36,
  dpi = 300
)

include_graphics("manuscript/contribution.jpg")

```
